mapper.sql: s.session_id AS sessionId, s.project_id AS projectId, s.city_name AS cityName, s.station_name AS stationName, s.venue_id AS venueId, v.venue_name AS venueName, s.start_time AS startTime, s.end_time AS endTime, s.sale_start_time AS saleStartTime, s.sale_end_time AS saleEndTime, s.issue_offset_hours AS issueOffsetHours, s.session_status AS sessionStatus, s.min_price AS minPrice, s.max_price AS maxPrice, s.limit_per_order AS limitPerOrder, s.delivery_type AS deliveryType, CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ticket_source_session_mapping tssm WHERE tssm.session_id=s.session_id) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS sourceManaged, (SELECT tsp.provider_code FROM ticket_source_session_mapping tssm JOIN ticket_source_provider tsp ON tsp.provider_id=tssm.provider_id WHERE tssm.session_id=s.session_id ORDER BY tssm.mapping_id LIMIT 1) AS providerCode, (SELECT tssm.provider_session_id FROM ticket_source_session_mapping tssm WHERE tssm.session_id=s.session_id ORDER BY tssm.mapping_id LIMIT 1) AS providerSessionId, s.station_detail_content AS stationDetailContent, s.create_time AS createTime, s.update_time AS updateTime, IFNULL(sku_stat.sku_count, 0) AS skuCount, CASE WHEN p.project_status <> 'OFFLINE' AND s.session_status IN ('ON_SALE', 'PRESALE') THEN IFNULL(sku_stat.stock_available_count, 0) ELSE 0 END AS stockAvailableCount, IFNULL(sku_stat.sold_count, 0) AS soldCount

sku.sku_id AS skuId, sku.project_id AS projectId, sku.session_id AS sessionId, sku.sku_name AS skuName, sku.sku_desc AS skuDesc, sku.price AS price, sku.price_mode AS priceMode, CASE WHEN skm.mapping_id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS sourceManaged, tsp.provider_code AS providerCode, skm.provider_sku_id AS providerSkuId, skm.provider_sku_name AS providerSkuName, skm.face_price AS providerFacePrice, skm.sale_price AS providerSalePrice, skm.settlement_price AS settlementPrice, skm.mapping_status AS mappingStatus, skm.source_sale_status AS sourceSaleStatus, skm.inventory_mode AS inventoryMode, skm.available_stock_snapshot AS availableStockSnapshot, skm.last_sync_time AS sourceLastSyncTime, sku.stock_available AS stockAvailable, sku.stock_locked AS stockLocked, sku.sold_count AS soldCount, sku.sku_status AS skuStatus, sku.inventory_authority AS inventoryAuthority, sku.sort_order AS sortOrder, sku.version AS version, sku.create_time AS createTime, sku.update_time AS updateTime
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM performance_project p LEFT JOIN category c ON c.category_id = p.category_id

SELECT p.project_id AS projectId, p.title AS title, p.category_id AS categoryId, c.category_name AS categoryName, p.poster_url AS posterUrl, p.min_price AS minPrice, p.max_price AS maxPrice, p.want_count AS wantCount, p.hot_score AS hotScore, p.project_status AS projectStatus, p.recommend_flag AS recommendFlag, CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ticket_source_project_mapping tpm WHERE tpm.project_id=p.project_id) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS sourceManaged, (SELECT tsp.provider_code FROM ticket_source_project_mapping tpm JOIN ticket_source_provider tsp ON tsp.provider_id=tpm.provider_id WHERE tpm.project_id=p.project_id ORDER BY tpm.mapping_id LIMIT 1) AS providerCode, (SELECT tpm.provider_project_id FROM ticket_source_project_mapping tpm WHERE tpm.project_id=p.project_id ORDER BY tpm.mapping_id LIMIT 1) AS providerProjectId, p.publish_time AS publishTime, p.update_time AS updateTime, IFNULL(s_stat.session_count, 0) AS sessionCount, IFNULL(s_stat.on_sale_session_count, 0) AS onSaleSessionCount, CASE WHEN p.project_status <> 'OFFLINE' THEN IFNULL(sku_stat.stock_available_count, 0) ELSE 0 END AS stockAvailableCount, IFNULL(sku_stat.sold_count, 0) AS soldCount FROM performance_project p LEFT JOIN category c ON c.category_id = p.category_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT project_id, COUNT(*) AS session_count, SUM(CASE WHEN session_status = 'ON_SALE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS on_sale_session_count FROM performance_session GROUP BY project_id ) s_stat ON s_stat.project_id = p.project_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT sku.project_id, SUM(CASE WHEN sku.sku_status IN ('ON_SALE', 'PRESALE') THEN sku.stock_available ELSE 0 END) AS stock_available_count, SUM(sku.sold_count) AS sold_count FROM ticket_sku sku JOIN performance_session s ON s.session_id = sku.session_id WHERE s.session_status IN ('ON_SALE', 'PRESALE') GROUP BY sku.project_id ) sku_stat ON sku_stat.project_id = p.project_id
ORDER BY p.update_time DESC, p.project_id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT p.project_id AS projectId, p.title AS title, p.category_id AS categoryId, c.category_name AS categoryName, p.poster_url AS posterUrl, p.detail_content AS detailContent, p.min_price AS minPrice, p.max_price AS maxPrice, p.want_count AS wantCount, p.hot_score AS hotScore, p.project_status AS projectStatus, p.recommend_flag AS recommendFlag, CASE WHEN tpm.mapping_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS sourceManaged, tsp.provider_code AS providerCode, tpm.provider_project_id AS providerProjectId, COALESCE(mp.source_project_name, tpm.provider_project_name) AS providerProjectName, mp.subtitle AS providerSubtitle, mp.introduction AS providerIntroduction, mp.poster_url AS providerPosterUrl, COALESCE(NULLIF(mp.detail_content, ''), mp.detail_html) AS providerDetailContent, COALESCE(mp.sale_status, tpm.source_sale_status) AS providerSaleStatus, COALESCE(mp.source_status_text, tpm.source_status_text) AS providerStatusText, tpm.mapping_status AS mappingStatus, tpm.last_sync_status AS lastSyncStatus, tpm.last_sync_time AS lastSyncTime, tpm.source_updated_time AS sourceUpdatedTime, tpm.auto_publish_enabled AS autoPublishEnabled, p.publish_time AS publishTime, p.create_time AS createTime, p.update_time AS updateTime FROM performance_project p LEFT JOIN category c ON c.category_id = p.category_id LEFT JOIN ticket_source_project_mapping tpm ON tpm.project_id = p.project_id LEFT JOIN ticket_source_provider tsp ON tsp.provider_id = tpm.provider_id LEFT JOIN mock_ticket_source_project mp ON mp.source_project_id = tpm.provider_project_id AND tsp.provider_code = 'MOCK_DAMAI' WHERE p.project_id = #{projectId} LIMIT 1

SELECT effective_tags.tag_name FROM ( SELECT st.tag_id, st.tag_name, rel.sort_order FROM project_service_tag_rel rel JOIN service_tag st ON st.tag_id = rel.tag_id WHERE rel.project_id = #{projectId} AND st.tag_name NOT IN ('条件退', '不可退')
UNION ALL
SELECT st.tag_id, st.tag_name, 99 AS sort_order FROM refund_rule rr JOIN service_tag st ON ( (rr.refund_type = 'CONDITIONAL_REFUND' AND st.tag_name = '条件退') OR (rr.refund_type = 'NO_REFUND' AND st.tag_name = '不可退') ) WHERE rr.project_id = #{projectId} ) effective_tags GROUP BY effective_tags.tag_id, effective_tags.tag_name ORDER BY MIN(effective_tags.sort_order) ASC, effective_tags.tag_id ASC
SELECT ni.title FROM project_notice_rel rel JOIN notice_item ni ON ni.notice_id = rel.notice_id WHERE rel.project_id = #{projectId} ORDER BY rel.sort_order ASC, rel.rel_id ASC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM performance_project WHERE project_id = #{projectId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM category WHERE category_id = #{categoryId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO performance_project ( title, category_id, poster_url, detail_content, min_price, max_price, want_count, hot_score, project_status, recommend_flag, publish_time, create_time, update_time ) VALUES ( #{title}, #{categoryId}, #{posterUrl}, #{detailContent}, NULL, NULL, 0, #{hotScore}, #{projectStatus}, #{recommendFlag}, #{publishTime}, NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE performance_project SET title = #{title}, category_id = #{categoryId}, poster_url = #{posterUrl}, detail_content = #{detailContent}, hot_score = #{hotScore}, project_status = #{projectStatus}, recommend_flag = #{recommendFlag}, publish_time = #{publishTime}, update_time = NOW() WHERE project_id = #{projectId}

UPDATE performance_project SET
project_status = #{projectStatus}, publish_time = CASE WHEN #{projectStatus} <> 'OFFLINE' THEN IFNULL(publish_time, NOW()) ELSE publish_time END,
recommend_flag = #{recommendFlag},
update_time = NOW() WHERE project_id = #{projectId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s.session_id) FROM performance_session s WHERE s.project_id = #{projectId} AND ( (#{projectStatus} = 'ON_SALE' AND s.session_status = 'ON_SALE' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ticket_sku sku WHERE sku.session_id = s.session_id AND sku.sku_status = 'ON_SALE' AND sku.stock_available > 0 )) OR (#{projectStatus} = 'COMING_SOON' AND s.session_status IN ('PRESALE', 'ON_SALE') AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ticket_sku sku WHERE sku.session_id = s.session_id AND sku.sku_status IN ('PRESALE', 'ON_SALE') AND sku.stock_available > 0 )) OR (#{projectStatus} = 'SOLD_OUT' AND s.session_status IN ('SOLD_OUT', 'ENDED', 'ON_SALE', 'PRESALE') AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ticket_sku sku WHERE sku.session_id = s.session_id AND sku.sku_status <> 'OFFLINE' )) )

SELECT
FROM performance_session s JOIN performance_project p ON p.project_id = s.project_id LEFT JOIN venue v ON v.venue_id = s.venue_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT session_id, COUNT(*) AS sku_count, SUM(CASE WHEN sku_status IN ('ON_SALE', 'PRESALE') THEN stock_available ELSE 0 END) AS stock_available_count, SUM(sold_count) AS sold_count FROM ticket_sku GROUP BY session_id ) sku_stat ON sku_stat.session_id = s.session_id WHERE s.project_id = #{projectId} ORDER BY s.start_time ASC, s.session_id ASC

SELECT
FROM performance_session s JOIN performance_project p ON p.project_id = s.project_id LEFT JOIN venue v ON v.venue_id = s.venue_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT session_id, COUNT(*) AS sku_count, SUM(CASE WHEN sku_status IN ('ON_SALE', 'PRESALE') THEN stock_available ELSE 0 END) AS stock_available_count, SUM(sold_count) AS sold_count FROM ticket_sku GROUP BY session_id ) sku_stat ON sku_stat.session_id = s.session_id WHERE s.session_id = #{sessionId} LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM performance_session WHERE session_id = #{sessionId}
SELECT project_id FROM performance_session WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM venue WHERE venue_id = #{venueId}
SELECT city_name FROM venue WHERE venue_id = #{venueId} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO performance_session ( project_id, city_name, station_name, venue_id, start_time, end_time, sale_start_time, sale_end_time, issue_offset_hours, session_status, min_price, max_price, limit_per_order, station_detail_content, delivery_type, create_time, update_time ) VALUES ( #{projectId}, #{cityName}, #{stationName}, #{venueId}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{saleStartTime}, #{saleEndTime}, #{issueOffsetHours}, #{sessionStatus}, NULL, NULL, #{limitPerOrder}, #{stationDetailContent}, #{deliveryType}, NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE performance_session SET city_name = #{cityName}, station_name = #{stationName}, venue_id = #{venueId}, start_time = #{startTime}, end_time = #{endTime}, sale_start_time = #{saleStartTime}, sale_end_time = #{saleEndTime}, issue_offset_hours = #{issueOffsetHours}, session_status = #{sessionStatus}, limit_per_order = #{limitPerOrder}, station_detail_content = #{stationDetailContent}, delivery_type = #{deliveryType}, update_time = NOW() WHERE session_id = #{sessionId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ticket_sku WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} AND ( (#{sessionStatus} = 'ON_SALE' AND sku_status = 'ON_SALE' AND stock_available > 0) OR (#{sessionStatus} = 'PRESALE' AND sku_status IN ('PRESALE', 'ON_SALE') AND stock_available > 0) OR (#{sessionStatus} = 'SOLD_OUT' AND sku_status <> 'OFFLINE') )
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ticket_order WHERE session_id = #{sessionId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ticket_sku WHERE session_id = #{sessionId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM banner_item WHERE target_session_id = #{sessionId}

SELECT
FROM ticket_sku sku LEFT JOIN ticket_source_sku_mapping skm ON skm.sku_id=sku.sku_id LEFT JOIN ticket_source_provider tsp ON tsp.provider_id=skm.provider_id WHERE sku.session_id = #{sessionId} ORDER BY sku.sort_order ASC, sku.sku_id ASC

SELECT
FROM ticket_sku sku LEFT JOIN ticket_source_sku_mapping skm ON skm.sku_id=sku.sku_id LEFT JOIN ticket_source_provider tsp ON tsp.provider_id=skm.provider_id WHERE sku.sku_id = #{skuId} LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ticket_sku WHERE sku_id = #{skuId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ticket_sku ( project_id, session_id, sku_name, sku_desc, price, stock_available, stock_locked, sold_count, sku_status, sort_order, version, create_time, update_time ) VALUES ( #{projectId}, #{sessionId}, #{skuName}, #{skuDesc}, #{price}, #{stockAvailable}, 0, 0, #{skuStatus}, #{sortOrder}, 0, NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE ticket_sku SET sku_name = #{skuName}, sku_desc = #{skuDesc}, price = #{price}, sku_status = #{skuStatus}, sort_order = #{sortOrder}, version = version + 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE sku_id = #{skuId}

UPDATE ticket_sku SET stock_available = #{stockAvailable},
sku_status = #{skuStatus},
update_time = NOW(), version = version + 1 WHERE sku_id = #{skuId} AND version = #{version} AND inventory_authority = 'LOCAL_COMPAT'
mapper.select: SELECT sale_price FROM ticket_source_sku_mapping WHERE sku_id=#{skuId} AND mapping_status='BOUND' ORDER BY mapping_id LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM order_item WHERE sku_id = #{skuId}
mapper.update: UPDATE performance_project SET min_price = ( SELECT MIN(sku.price) FROM ticket_sku sku JOIN performance_session s ON s.session_id = sku.session_id WHERE sku.project_id = #{projectId} AND sku.sku_status <> 'OFFLINE' AND s.session_status <> 'OFFLINE' ), max_price = ( SELECT MAX(sku.price) FROM ticket_sku sku JOIN performance_session s ON s.session_id = sku.session_id WHERE sku.project_id = #{projectId} AND sku.sku_status <> 'OFFLINE' AND s.session_status <> 'OFFLINE' ), update_time = NOW() WHERE project_id = #{projectId}
